sequences.name: Spectator
sequences.potion_overview: A sticky silver liquid filled with countless bubbles, creating a serene atmosphere.

supplementary_ingredients: 80 milliliters of Purified Water
5 drops of Autumn Crocus Essence
13 grams of Cow Teeth Paeonol Powder
7 petals of elf flowers

sequences.acting_method: Whether it is at an extravagant banquet or in a lively street, a Spectator is always just a spectator - they can never take the stage themselves. Spectators do not spy, Spectators should watch openly and honestly from their positions.
sequences.consumption_backlash: The sticky silver potion would turn them into exactly what the name promises: an observer locked out of their own life. Their limbs would feel distant, their words slow to arrive, and an irresistible urge to simply watch would settle over them—watching conversations they should join, opportunities they should seize, moments passing like a play they had no ticket to participate in. The bubbles in the potion would rise behind their eyes. Only by practicing the spectator's discipline deliberately—observing with purpose, cataloging what they see, choosing when to remain still—would the detachment become a tool rather than a cage, leaving them a watcher whose stillness is a choice and whose eyes miss nothing.

sequences.name: Telepathist
sequences.potion_overview: A liquid exhibiting constantly changing lusters capable of shining into the depths of everyone's hearts.

main_ingredients: Rainbow Salamander (Phantom Netherdrake)'s complete pituitary gland
10 milliliters of a Farsman Rabbit (Half Specter Rabbit)'s spinal fluid
supplementary_ingredients: 5 grams of Chestnut Spore
8 grams of Dragon Tooth Grass Powder
3 petals of Pure White Elf Flowers
100 milliliters Purified Water

sequences.acting_method: Do not abrupt or act against logic and reason.
sequences.consumption_backlash: They would blank out, with the view around them appearing to be a blur or a haze. This period of backlash would last far longer than Spectator. And after a while, their view before them would clear up significantly.

sequences.name: Psychiatrist (Psyche Analyst)
sequences.potion_overview: The slightly golden liquid rippled like a deformed, gigantic pupil, its gaze seeming to penetrate into the depths of anyone's heart. It tastes cool and refreshing, like enjoying delicious ice cream.
sequences.beyonder_characteristic_appearance: A huge golden iris that could expose the thoughts of everyone's hearts

main_ingredients: The fruit of the Tree of Elders
A pair of eyes from a Mirror Dragon
supplementary_ingredients: 50 milliliters of Mirror Dragon's Blood
15 grams of Tree of Elders Bark Powder
10 drops of Foxglove essential oil
9 strands of infant hair

sequences.acting_method: Help others solve their mental problems. People wear different personality masks when facing different situations and problems.
sequences.consumption_backlash: Their sense of hearing would suddenly reach out, enough to hear the conversation at the end of the corridor outside the room they're in. They would feel that they would dissolve into an illusory gas and are rapidly expanding. It would fill the entire room, overlapping with a sea formed from everyone's sea of consciousness. Their vision would also change. Everything they see is abnormally smooth, turning into a mirror that reflects their current appearance. Scales would appear growing out of their exposed skin. Their irises would also contract, being dyed with a faint golden colour, as if they had turned vertical like a cat's eye or a dragon's rather. Clearly, they're turning into an inhuman monster. With a hum, their mind began to turn into a blur, as if something was slowly and painfully drilling out from the surface of their body. They would then have to recover their thoughts and try to get themself into a Spectator state. Calming down their undulating emotions quickly, and their spirit would seem to leave their body. Looking down at themself like a spectator. The scales on the surface of their body would visibly recede and their eyes return to normal. It didn't take them long to regain control of their body and understand what Beyonder powers are available to a Psychiatrist and how they are used.

sequences.name: Hypnotist
sequences.potion_overview: A translucent, colorless, sticky liquid that resembles a mirror when still, perfectly reflecting its surroundings. When disturbed, tiny whirlpools silently spin beneath its surface. It may bring about brief chill on consumption.
sequences.beyonder_characteristic_appearance: The transparent, colorless mucus had lost its binding substance, leaving it only able to condense independently, eventually forming a sticky grayish-white colloid. From a distance, this colloid resembled an unfixed mirror, capable of reflecting everything around it. Minuscule transparent bubbles deep within the colloid. They caught and refracted sunlight from various angles, displaying an array of colors. The colorless colloid with numerous bubbles

main_ingredients: The complete pituitary gland of an adolescent Mind Dragon OR 60 milliliters of a Black-hunting Giant Lizard's spinal fluid
The fruit of an Illusory Chime Tree
supplementary_ingredients: 80 milliliters of blood from an adolescent Mind Dragon (or black-hunt giant lizard)
3 scales from an adolescent Mind Dragon (or 3 pieces of bark from the Illusory Chime Tree)
1 belladonna fruit
A mirror kept in one's own room for over three months

sequences.acting_method: Guide others into the sleep they need, and never command what was not surrendered. A Hypnotist induces trance with voice, rhythm, and patience—helping the haunted rest, the addicted break free, and the suffering find peace beneath their waking mind. Never plant what was not agreed upon, and never deepen a trance past its purpose; the mind entrusted to you is a guest in your care, not a puppet awaiting strings.
sequences.consumption_backlash: After a brief chill, their mind would suddenly feel like exploding. Their body also seems to be contaminated as it turns somewhat incorporeal. At that moment, their Soul Body, Astral Projection, and Ether Body are being absorbed and assimilated by their Body of Heart and Mind. Their entire person is like an amalgamation of pure thoughts that begin churning. They would feel the boundless Sea of Collective Subconscious which connected all living creatures, and they would sense the spirituality sky that stands in contrast. They would experience the sense of alarm and maintain a sliver of lucidity and curb their instinctive urge to fuse into the 'sea'. They would allow their consciousness to spread out in all directions before contracting like a rubber band. Their exposed skin would be convered in scales, and their hair mutated. After an unknown period of time, they would eventually find their inner self and see their appearance. The aforementioned mutations would eventually recede and eventually recover. However, they would find their eyes appear clear, but deep down is a strange bottomless whirlpool. It made it difficult for others to shift their gaze away from them, easily drowning within them. This is a sign of dispersing spirituality.

sequences.name: Dreamwalker
sequences.potion_overview: The potion appears to be a liquid dotted with darkened points of grayish-white light. The potion tastes a little sour, a little sweet, a little bitter, a little surreal, and a little stimulating, like a wild dream one could let themselves loose in.
sequences.beyonder_characteristic_appearance: A large amount of grayish-white matter that had been purged. It flowed freely, forming a heart-shaped object the size of a child's fist. Not only were there wrinkles on it, but there were also cracks that resembled eyes. As for the complicated, three-dimensional, illusory patterns, labels, and symbols that extended into the void

main_ingredients: An adult mind dragon's complete brain OR A Dream Catcher's Heart
supplementary_ingredients: 100 milliliters of Blood of an Adult Mind Dragon (or 90 milliliters of Blood of a Dream Catcher)
3 scales of an Adult Mind Dragon (Or 3 grams of Mind Illusion Remnant Dust)
1 Off-White Dragon's Breath Grass
3 Treeman leaves

sequences.advancement_ritual: Seek out a harpy in the Spirit World and sign a contract with it. Then, holding one tail feather, consume the potion amidst intense feelings of either joy or anger.
sequences.ritual_essence: The entire ritual's essence is to be immersed in a dream and be unwilling to wake up from it. Get pulled out of the dream via an external force, or else you might sleep forever or lose control and turn into a monster. A harpy is needed because it has the ability to give nightmares, it can snap people awake from their dreams. The Harpy can be replaced by something equivalent, for example Audrey used The Fool's Angel's Embrace to remain lucid in the dream instead.
sequences.acting_method: Come, see, record, but do not interfere, be a Spectator. Proactively walk among the dreams. If you really want to interfere, then be the mastermind and conductor behind the scenes; even if your goal is achieved, no one should notice.
sequences.consumption_backlash: Before they could feel the effects that the potion exerted on their body, they were suddenly startled before they regained consciousness. They would see scenes of a perfect world, their hopes for the future fulfilled, their ideas fully realised. As for them, it is as if they had become a ruler of this world. They would feel their Astral Projection rise up once again, breaking out of the confines of the hazy world. They would see that their dream is like a huge bubble that grew out from the island of consciousness while silently enveloping it. Deep within it was a silent, undulating, shimmering 'wavy' illusory sea that seemed bottomless. This is the Sea of Collective Subconscious, the scene of a mind world for a Dreamwalker. They would then forcefully escape from their dream.

sequences.name: Manipulator
sequences.potion_overview: Countless points of light float within the potion, resembling the manifestation of the Sea of Collective Subconscious. When advancing, one couldn't even process the taste, or feel the potion being gulped down before feeling the backlash.
sequences.beyonder_characteristic_appearance: ist-sized object resembled a heart and brain, adorned with grayish-white wrinkles and intricate symbols. It connected to an unseen realm, embodying a child-sized, grayish-white, wrinkled 'heart.'

main_ingredients: A complete brain of an Elderly Mind Dragon OR Crystalline heart of a Tree Mentor
supplementary_ingredients: 80 milliliters of Elderly Mind Dragon blood
Three pieces of a Tree Mentor's Golden Leaf
7 different drop of tears from different humans or non-human creatures that were shed due to intense emotion

sequences.advancement_ritual: In the middle of a grand event with at least 10,000 people, resonate with their emotions, then take the potion.
sequences.ritual_essence: Ten thousand hearts beating in the same excitement create a wave in the Sea of Collective Subconscious—and by resonating with it, the advancer learns to ride the wave rather than be drowned by it. The grand event's collective emotion becomes their introduction to the sea's true scale: proof that they can touch the mind of the crowd and remain themselves. This resonance is the foundation upon which all manipulation is built, for one cannot steer what one has never felt from within.
sequences.acting_method: Move hearts as a puppeteer moves strings—gently, purposefully, and without visible hands. A Manipulator guides emotions, shapes desires, and steers decisions while those guided believe the will is their own. Study what people truly want beneath what they say, and never push harder than the heart will naturally bend; the finest manipulation leaves its subject grateful.
sequences.consumption_backlash: They would immediately feel abnormal. They could no longer sense their body. Their entire being seems to have condensed into an idea as they merge into the illusory sea around them. For most of them, this may be the first time directly seeing the Sea of Collective Subconscious without passing through a dream or a mind island. As though they had returned to their mother's embrace before they were born, they would return to the very beginning where the imprints left by human ancestors were washed away by the tides as they crumbled and were influenced. There is fear, madness, and all kinds of terrifying mental corruption. For a moment, they would find it difficult to resist. Their consciousness would fade, and their 'body' shakes as though it is on the brink of melting away. The 'sea' nearby wouldn't be serene. There is a certain degree of undulation, spreading the intense sorrow and pain around. Under such influence, the self-aware them, who are about to be assimilated by the Sea of Collective Subconscious, also began to resonate, generating uncontrollable feelings of the corresponding emotions within them. The emotions spread from one thought to another. Soon, it filled the blob of 'thoughts' that they had mutated into. It would pierce through their Soul Body and pierce their soul. They would finally regain a little of their senses. They have to skillfully Placate themself, constantly giving cues to remove the corruption until they regain their senses. The voice in their ears would become clearer and clearer, louder and louder. Finally, it reverberated through the sea of collective subconscious. They would then split themself into many transparent and illusory bodies and traveled through the Sea of Collective Subconscious and reached the mind islands that represented different people and stepped onto them. In these 'places,' they could clearly see the corresponding emotions coming from different people. And even scenes that caused these emotions. Inevitably, the advancer has completely sympathised with the surrounding people.

sequences.name: Dream Weaver
sequences.beyonder_characteristic_appearance: Formed from thin mist, seemingly an ,unreal, grayish-white brain from a dream

main_ingredients: The crystalline heart of the Treant King OR The complete brain of a Dream Dragon
supplementary_ingredients: 100 milliliters of Treant King sap (or Dream Dragon blood)
9 strands of Hair each from 13 Intelligent Beings that died or went insane due to Nightmares
1 Sapling
10 drops of Nightmare Grass juice

sequences.advancement_ritual: Cause at least 100,000 people to have the same dream on the same night.
sequences.ritual_essence: A hundred thousand dreams sharing one shape is no longer a dream—it is a shared reality woven in sleep. By casting a single dream across so many sleeping minds, the advancer proves mastery over the dream-stuff itself: the ability to write upon the unconscious of a city. The thirteen strands of nightmare-touched hair remind them of the responsibility this power carries, for a weaver who can give a hundred thousand people one dream can just as easily give them one nightmare.
sequences.acting_method: Weave dreams as a weaver weaves cloth—thread by thread, pattern by pattern, with the whole design in mind. A Dream Walker who becomes a Dream Weaver builds dreams with intention: sanctuaries for the tormented, rehearsals for the uncertain, and lessons for those who learn best in sleep. Never weave carelessly, for a dream once given takes root in the dreamer's waking life.
sequences.consumption_backlash: The dark mist-like potion would seep into their mind, and every dream they had ever entered would unravel and reweave around them—threads of a hundred thousand sleeping minds pulling at their consciousness from all directions. They would feel themselves becoming the loom: aware of every dream within reach, tempted to tug every thread. The nine strands of nightmare-touched hair would whisper the patterns of terror. Only by weaving deliberately—choosing each thread, placing each pattern with intention—would the tangle resolve into craft, leaving them a weaver whose dreams are architecture and whose nightmares are never accidents.

sequences.name: Discerner
sequences.potion_overview: A ghastly pale liquid in which illusory vertical eyes repeatedly open and close.
sequences.beyonder_characteristic_appearance: A pale heart riddled with holes, inlaid with numerous vertical eyes

main_ingredients: The Pale heart of Ariehogg OR The Pale heart of another Ancient Mind Dragon
supplementary_ingredients: 90 milliliters of blood from an ancient Mind Dragon or Discerner
3 self-woven true identities
9 Black Flowers representing the Deepest, Most Vile, Most Terrifying Parts of the Human Heart
1 Feather of the Solar Divine Bird (non-tail feather)

sequences.advancement_ritual: Delve into the subconscious of at least ten thousand humans, uncover their deepest fears, most primal desires, and the root of all their psychological issues, then leave a mark of oneself.
sequences.ritual_essence: To discern is to see what a person cannot see about themselves—and to leave a mark in ten thousand subconscious minds is to inscribe one's understanding into the very fabric of human nature. The advancer who completes this ritual has cataloged the full anatomy of fear and desire across ten thousand souls, and the three self-woven identities prove they can wear any mind's perspective as their own. The nine Black Flowers are the receipt: proof they have seen the deepest, most vile parts of the human heart and returned with their own intact.
sequences.acting_method: See through everyone, and let no one see through you. A Discerner reads the hidden motives, buried fears, and true desires beneath every word and gesture—then chooses, with full knowledge, how to act. Maintain your woven identities flawlessly, never let your own mask slip, and remember that one who sees all hearts must guard their own most carefully, for it is the only one they cannot observe from outside.
sequences.consumption_backlash: The ghastly pale potion would open the illusory vertical eyes within them, and the ten thousand subconscious depths they had visited would flood back at once—every fear, every vile desire, every root of every wound, all speaking simultaneously. The three woven identities would pull at them, each insisting it was the real one. The Black Flowers would bloom in their mind, showing them the same darkness growing in their own heart. Only by holding the Solar Divine Bird's feather as their compass—clinging to one pure, unwavering point of light—would they sort the flood into knowledge rather than corruption, leaving them a Discerner who has seen everything human and remains human still.

sequences.name: Author
sequences.potion_overview: A transparent liquid in which countless images of fate and projections of various concepts are precipitated, appearing as tiny points of starlight.
sequences.beyonder_characteristic_appearance: A crystal-clear finger bone resembling a pen

supplementary_ingredients: 100 milliliters of Muddy Water from the underground Nightmare Swamp (Born under the influence of the 'Chaos Sea', widely present underground—yet approaching it means coming dangerously close to the Chaos Sea, so High Sequence powerhouses cannot personally retrieve it)
1 Fragment of a 'Meteor' fallen from the Astral World
9 of the Most Popular Novels or Fairy Tale Books of the Current Era
One's own depraved nature

sequences.advancement_ritual: Using real people as characters, write a medium- to long-length novel, and let the actual fates of those real people follow the story's plot to its conclusion, leaving corresponding imprints in both the Spirit World and the River of Fate.
sequences.ritual_essence: To write a fate and watch reality obey is the Author's proof of authority over the story of the world. The novel becomes a covenant inscribed in both the Spirit World and the River of Fate: the characters lived what was written, and the pen that wrote it is now recognized by destiny itself. Every plot point that came true is a clause in that covenant, and the Quill of Alzuhod is the instrument that makes the next story law.
sequences.acting_method: An Author decides how the story unfolds, where the characters go, what the ending is, or whether they can live happily ever after. However, their 'stories' cannot be illogical, otherwise they would disrupt the flow of reading. Therefore, a 'reasonable development' is always unfolding with each person being merely a word to be written under 'Their' pen.
sequences.consumption_backlash: The starlit potion would dissolve them into the story they had written, and they would experience their own plot from every character's perspective—the hero's hope, the villain's grievance, the bystander's confusion, all at once. Their own depraved nature, sealed in the formula, would attempt to write itself into the narrative as the true ending. The muddy swamp water would whisper that all stories end in the Chaos Sea. Only by holding the pen firmly—remembering that they are the author and not a character, that the story obeys them and not the reverse—would they write themselves back into control, leaving them an Author whose every subsequent word carries the weight of demonstrated fate.

sequences.name: Visionary
sequences.potion_overview: A golden potion that seems to contain a fantasy world within.

supplementary_ingredients: A Realm self-created from Fantasy or Dreams (this will later evolve into the Divine Kingdom upon becoming a God)

sequences.advancement_ritual: Make the development of the times align with one's expectations. Then, consume the potion for advancement when it's at a certain time node in that trend.
sequences.ritual_essence: An era is the longest story ever told, and to bend its development toward one's own expectations is to become its author at civilization's scale. The advancer who shapes the times proves that their imagination is no longer confined to dreams or books—it moves history. Consuming the potion at the trend's chosen node seals the covenant: the world that emerges from that turning point is one they envisioned, and the Visionary's fantasy realm becomes the seed of a Divine Kingdom rooted in a reshaped reality.
sequences.acting_method: You are the Visionary—the dreamer whose dreams the world eventually inhabits. Imagine boldly, for your imagination is the blueprint of what will be; envision fairly, for the world you build is the world all must live in. Guide the times with a storyteller's patience and a creator's responsibility, and never forget that the most powerful vision is one that others come to believe was always their own.
sequences.consumption_backlash: The golden potion would open within them like a world being born, and every possibility they had ever imagined would bloom at once—futures branching in infinite directions, each one demanding to be the one that comes true. The self-created realm in the formula would pull at their spirit, inviting them to retreat into their own fantasy and leave the real world to its own devices. The weight of the era they shaped would press on their mind: every life changed by the trend they set, every consequence still unfolding. Only by remaining the author rather than the audience—choosing which vision becomes real and accepting responsibility for it—would the infinite possibilities condense into a single golden reality, leaving them the Visionary: the being whose imagination is the world's future, and whose fantasy has become everyone's home.
